description: Source code for joystick hardware layer, handling external interrupts for joystick buttons, including initialization, callback handling, and status reporting.

methods.name: isJitter
methods.description: Detects if the current joystick event is likely just jitter based on timing.

methods.name: extCallback
methods.description: Interrupt callback for joystick external pins, updates button press counts and triggers joystick handling.

methods.name: joystickInfo
methods.description: Reports current joystick button press counts and status.

methods.name: isJoystickEnabled
methods.description: Checks if joystick pins are configured for use.

methods.name: initJoystick
methods.description: Initializes joystick external interrupts and configures GPIO pins.
